standards.title: Prudential Standard CPS 230 Operational Risk Management
companion_guidance: Prudential Practice Guide CPG 230 Operational Risk Management
standards.summary: CPS 230 sets out requirements for APRA-regulated entities to be resilient to operational risks and disruptions. It covers three main pillars: (1) Operational Risk Management (identifying, assessing, controlling, and reporting operational risks); (2) Business Continuity Management (defining critical operations, setting Board-approved tolerance levels for downtime, data loss, and service degradation, and testing credible BCPs); and (3) Service Provider Management (managing material service providers, fourth parties, mandatory agreement clauses, and submitting annual MSP registers to APRA).

standards.title: Prudential Standard CPS 234 Information Security
companion_guidance: Prudential Practice Guide CPG 234 Information Security
standards.summary: CPS 234 aims to ensure that an APRA-regulated entity takes measures to be resilient against information security incidents (including cyber-attacks) by maintaining an information security capability commensurate with vulnerabilities and threats. The Board is ultimately responsible. Key mandates include asset classification by criticality/sensitivity, control design and systematic testing by independent specialists, internal audit assurance (including third-party assurance), and strict APRA notification timeframes (within 72 hours for material incidents, and within 10 business days for material control weaknesses).
